scope.method: Compared the L0 fixture plan, report schema, review record, and progress against the authoritative v2 T05 card and referenced §04/§08 clauses; performed static JSON and structural checks only.

fixtureCases.ids: P01-P28 exactly once in the fixture plan and required exactly once by the report schema.
fixtureCases.execution: Plan remains preflight_only; executionStatus remains NOT_RUN; no P01-P28 behavior was run.

g0RuntimeGates: Added a planned, NOT_RUN observation gate for blocking synchronous process creation on interactive paths.
Added a planned, NOT_RUN observation gate proving interactions reuse the initialized helper instead of launching a helper per interaction.

measurements.normalText: PASS requires at least 100 successful samples, controlled_live observation mode, evidence references, p95 <150ms, and independent confirmation that synthetic text appeared in the controlled editor.
measurements.wakeToActionable: PASS requires at least 100 successful samples, controlled_live observation mode, evidence references, and p95 <100ms.
measurements.separateOutcomes: The report now has distinct successfulSampleCount, failureCount, cancellationCount, and timeoutCount fields and a sample outcome category; their consistency with raw samples still requires recomputation.
measurements.environment: A PASS report now requires Windows x64 plus nonempty OS, display, power, network, and dataset details and a nonempty source commit/branch.

passGates: T03 and T04 must both be accepted.
P01-P28 must appear exactly once and every reported result/assertion must pass with a nonempty evidence reference; the reviewer must still map all planned assertions one by one.
Both performance metrics must pass; a fake-only metric cannot satisfy a PASS report.
Both G0 runtime observation gates must pass.
Local package, helper resource, lifecycle, rollback, data compatibility, and autoPaste checks must pass with per-check evidence references.
notRun must be empty and publication must remain NOT_PUBLISHED.
Schema validity alone does not establish T05 acceptance; all manualReviewGates must be closed against actual evidence before accepting a PASS claim.
verified.helperAndRollback: PASS requires populated identity fields and evidence, identityMatched=true, an explicit valid or unsigned signature status, and helper-binary-only rollback. Identity equality and signature authenticity remain evidence-review responsibilities.

reviewChecks.jsonParse: PASS; fixture plan, report schema, review record, and progress parse as JSON.
reviewChecks.fixtureAndGateStructure: PASS; P01-P28 remain unique and ordered, both G0 gates are planned/NOT_RUN, and progress remains T05 not_started.
reviewChecks.draft202012Validator: NOT_RUN; no local Ajv validator is installed and no dependency was added.

schemaAuthority: STATIC_SCHEMA_REVIEW_ONLY; a schema-valid report is not sufficient evidence for T05 acceptance or a PASS claim.
limitations: Case IDs are constrained to P01-P28 exactly once, but the schema cannot bind each report assertion name to every exact fixture-plan assertion. A report can omit a planned assertion and still validate; the mapping remains a manual gate.

The schema cannot enforce unique sample requestIds or recompute percentiles and outcome counts from samples. successfulSampleCount, failureCount, cancellationCount, timeoutCount, p50/p95/max, and sample rows can still contradict one another until a reviewer reconciles them from raw evidence.

textAppearanceIndependentlyVerified remains a self-reported boolean. PASS now requires metric evidence references, but the schema cannot prove that the referenced evidence actually shows text in the controlled editor.

Helper and rollback expected/actual paths, versions, protocols, and hashes are reported alongside identityMatched=true, but JSON Schema cannot compare those paired values or authenticate a signature. signatureStatus still allows unsigned; the reviewer must establish whether that is acceptable for this internal artifact.

PASS checks now require nonempty per-assertion, per-check, and per-metric evidence references. The schema cannot resolve paths, establish repository locality, verify file existence/hashes, or prove that a referenced artifact contains the claimed command output.
G0 runtime results and T03/T04 dependencyGate values are report inputs; reviewers must inspect process traces and cross-check dependency status with docs/progress.json and acceptance evidence.
All P01-P28 behavior, G0 process observation, controlled desktop measurements, Windows packaging, lifecycle, rollback, clipboard/input, and publication remain NOT_RUN.
manualReviewGates: Before accepting any case result, map every fixture-plan assertion for P01-P28 one by one to a recorded assertion and evidence item; reject missing, extra, or mismatched mappings.

For both timing metrics, inspect at least 100 unique successful run/request IDs, verify controlled_live mode and all fixed environment controls, recompute p50/p95/max and failure/cancellation/timeout totals from raw per-run measurements, and attach independent evidence of synthetic text appearing in the controlled editor.
Inspect process-creation traces for interactive paths and helper process identities across repeated requests; verify no blocking synchronous spawn call and no new helper process per interaction.

Compare helper expected identity to the actual packaged resource and rollback identity to the previously verified helper using artifact path, version, protocol, SHA-256, signature result, and command output; do not trust identityMatched alone.

Resolve every evidence reference to an existing repository-local artifact, inspect its contents, verify recorded hashes and commands, and confirm evidence is attached to the specific assertion, check, or metric it supports.
Cross-check T03/T04 accepted status against docs/progress.json and their supporting acceptance evidence; a report's dependencyGate fields or schema-valid PASS cannot substitute for this check.
Keep T05 not_started/NOT_RUN until T04 is accepted and all required behavior, controlled desktop, package, rollback, and independent review evidence is actually completed.
